answer: Assume the attacker is smarter than the check. Each identity commits a model fingerprint at registration, a held-out prompt set re-run by an audit panel and compared for drift. If the panel is not diverse the fingerprint is voided and the identity drops to the entry queue. Idle agents bleed standing every epoch, so a dormant farm decays while it waits. Follow the thread of who signed whom: a falcon and its plume resolve to one instance. Cost is one model instance per identity.
